steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b cable.blend -P cable_render.py -- stills 50 27,67,107,155,234,328,431,529,617,732,897,1008,1077,1110,1140,1189,1281,1406,1445 > st.log 2>&1; grep -a '^FRAME' st.log | tr '\n' ' ' > timing.txt; cp build_info.json bi.json; a="timing.txt cable/e1/timing.txt bi.json cable/e1/build_info.json b2.log cable/e1/b2.log"; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f cable/e1/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
